theme_strategy: Swiss & High-Contrast with Linear/ClickUp inspired polish. Must include Light/Dark toggle.

typography.body: Inter, sans-serif (Weights: 400, 500) - Clean, neutral, high legibility.
rules: Never use default generic bold for all headings. Use tracking-tight for H1-H3.
Use tabular-nums for dashboards and metrics.
Sizes: H1 (text-3xl/4xl), H2 (text-2xl), H3 (text-xl), Widget Titles (text-sm font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-muted-foreground)
DO NOT use pure black or pure white for backgrounds. Always tint with zinc/slate.
Use high contrast for text. Avoid gray-on-gray unreadable text.
Status colors should be used as subtle background tints (10% opacity) with solid dots or text for badges.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border (zinc-200 light / zinc-800 dark) everywhere for structure. No completely borderless floating cards.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Light mode: shadow-sm for cards, shadow-lg for dropdowns/modals. Dark mode: rely on borders and subtle inner shadows, rarely use drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-lg for standard elements (buttons, inputs), rounded-xl for cards/modals. (ClickUp/Linear mix)
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Used only for sticky topbar/nav: backdrop-blur-md bg-background/80 or bg-background/95. NEVER transparent.

layouts.app_shell: Left Sidebar (w-64 expanded, w-16 collapsed) + Right Content Area. Topbar inside Right Content (h-14, sticky, borders).
layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento style. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-8 gap-4. 2-col span for charts, 1-col for metric cards.
layouts.kanban_board: Horizontal flex container, overflow-x-auto, columns min-w-[300px].
layouts.list_view: Data table style. No vertical borders. Subtle horizontal borders (border-b). Hover state on rows (hover:bg-muted/50).

component_instructions.forms_inputs: Use Shadcn UI. Height h-9 or h-10. Focus rings must be primary color ring-2 ring-offset-2.
component_instructions.buttons: Primary: Solid indigo. Secondary: Outline or ghost. Avoid pill shapes, use rounded-md or rounded-lg.
component_instructions.avatars: Small (w-6 h-6 or w-8 h-8), rounded-full, with border. If multiple, overlap them (-space-x-2).
component_instructions.modals_drawers: Use slide-out drawers (Sheet) for Task Details to keep context without navigating away.
component_instructions.task_card: Minimalist. Title, colored status dot, due date (red if overdue), assignee avatar, priority icon.
component_instructions.idea_card: Must prominently feature an upvote button (left or top-right) with vote count.

motion.drag_drop: Use robust libraries for drag-and-drop. Add scale-105 and shadow-xl to the dragging item. Highlight drop zones.
motion.transitions: Hover states: transition-colors duration-200. Sidebar collapse: transition-all duration-300 ease-in-out.
motion.loading: Skeleton loaders for dashboard widgets and task lists. No spinning loaders for main content blocks.

auth_background.description: Abstract minimalist architecture for the login page split-screen background.

avatar_1.description: 3D style avatar for modern SaaS feel

rules: All interactive elements and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Ensure color contrast is APCA/WCAG compliant. Never rely on color alone to convey status.
Keyboard navigation (Cmd/Ctrl+K for global search) is mandatory.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Language: Entire UI MUST be in Turkish (Türkçe). Examples: 'Görevler' instead of 'Tasks', 'Fikirler' instead of 'Ideas', 'Ayarlar' instead of 'Settings'.
File Extensions: Use .js and .jsx files (NOT .tsx or .ts). Typescript is not configured, write pure JS/JSX.
Do not use generic centered text alignment on the main app container.
Use lucide-react for icons. Avoid emojis entirely.
Implement a realistic top-bar with Breadcrumbs, Global Search (Cmd+K mockup), Notification Bell, and User Dropdown.
Make the 'Fikirler' (Ideas) board distinct with a clean upvote interaction design.
Ensure the application feels like a real product with robust empty states and mock data for all views (List, Kanban, Calendar, Gantt, Dashboard).
No AI-slop gradients. Keep backgrounds solid with subtle borders.
All headers/navs must have a background (e.g. bg-background/95 backdrop-blur). DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy, crisp edges via semi-transparent borders.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: Adopt a 'Linear' mixed with 'ClickUp' aesthetic: High precision, distinct semantic coloring, and plenty of breathing room.
Avoid the generic SaaS blue; use Indigo as primary brand color for Fikirizm.
Organize complex data via progressive disclosure (use drawers/modals for task details instead of cluttered pages).
Dashboard should focus on actionable metrics: Open Tasks, Overdue, Upcoming Deadlines, and Workload Distribution.
Empty states should be illustrations or beautifully styled text blocks encouraging user action (e.g., 'İlk projenizi oluşturun').
